edges.reason: delegate() requires msg.sender == owner, so the owner address gates arbitrary delegatecall execution.
msg.sender must equal owner before the delegatecall in delegate() executes.
delegate() performs delegatecall with caller-supplied target and calldata.
transferFrom uses msg.sender both as spender for allowance checks and as the value passed to checkBots.
transfer() forwards msg.sender as _from to transferFrom.
The checkBots modifier attached to transferFrom performs a low-level external call before any allowance or balance state is modified.
The external call to botProtection can re-enter transferFrom (or transfer) before balances and allowances are updated.
The botProtection state variable is the external call target invoked before state updates.
transferFrom updates allowance and balances using raw unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are mutated without SafeMath overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented without SafeMath underflow protection.
list() performs a low-level call to botProtection with selector 0xd5eaf4c3.
The botProtection state variable is the target of the low-level call in list().
list() requires msg.sender == owner before performing privileged operations.
The owner address gates the privileged list() function.
block.timestamp is read in list() to compute the router deadline, making execution time dependent.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, a miner-influenceable value.
list() invokes pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and the token balance.
The pancakeRouter state variable is the router contract invoked by the external call.
list() writes recipient balances in a loop without overflow or bounds checks.
list() overwrites balanceOf entries for the token contract, the caller and each recipient.
The constructor derives ownership and allowances from tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
owner is assigned from tx.origin inside the BackedToken constructor.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1) in the constructor, granting tx.origin unlimited spending rights.
The constructor calls pairForPancake to derive the uniPair address.
uniPair is assigned in the constructor from the pairForPancake result.
The constructor grants the pancakeRouter an unlimited allowance.
wrappedEther is passed together with address(this) into pairForPancake.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 with unchecked multiplication.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the owner of the written allowance entry.
The BotProtected constructor sets the botProtection state variable.
The BackedToken constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor with _botProtection.
ERC20.transfer delegates to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates allowance update to _approve.
ERC20.transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the allowance safely.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
ERC20._transfer uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
ERC20._mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balances.
ERC20._burn uses SafeMath.sub for supply and balances.
ERC20.increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub.
checkBots._from is an input parameter of the checkBots modifier.
checkBots._to is an input parameter of the checkBots modifier.
checkBots._value is an input parameter of the checkBots modifier.
checkBots.notABot is the local success flag produced and required inside the modifier.
checkBots.isNotBot is the local bytes payload returned inside the modifier.
transferFrom._from determines which balance and allowance entry is debited.
transferFrom._to determines which balance entry is credited.
transferFrom._value is used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
transfer._to is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer._value is forwarded to transferFrom.
approve._spender is the allowance key written by approve.
approve._value is the allowance value written by approve.
delegate.a is the delegatecall target supplied to the delegatecall in delegate().
delegate.b is the calldata supplied to the delegatecall in delegate().
list._numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and the token liquidity amount.
list._reallyGoHere supplies the recipients iterated in the list() loop.
list._amounts supplies the balances written in the list() loop.
list.i is the loop index controlling balance rewrites inside list().
BackedToken.constructor._botProtection is forwarded to BotProtected.
BotProtected.constructor._botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable.
